dog.description_text:
Rhinestone is a 3-year-old mixed breed who weighs around 38 lbs, and she really is a gem. She’s affectionate, curious, pretty quiet, and genuinely loves people. Meeting someone new is very exciting in Rhinestone’s world, and she’s always ready to make a new friend.

She also does great with other dogs and is crate-trained. On walks, she’s learning that she doesn’t actually need to say hello to every single person or dog she sees, even if she would very much like to. She’s easily excited, very social, and her tail seems to have a mind of its own once it gets going.

Rhinestone has a lovely mix of sweetness and enthusiasm. She enjoys being close to her people, loves exploring what’s around her, and brings a lot of warmth without being overly demanding.

Registered adopters interested in Rhinestone can email adopt@hbrdogs.com for more info. If you're not registered yet, do it today at hbrdogs.com!
